title: The Anniversary Sweepstakes
logline: When a superstitious dock gambler accidentally buys a duplicated winning ticket for the station manager's private anniversary sweepstakes, bailiffs scramble to seize the slip.

roles.description: Believes station atmospheric hums predict lucky lottery digits; currently sleeping in a borrowed airlock.
Operates the station betting kiosk; sells lucky crystals and quietly covers register shortfalls with counterfeit stubs.
A terrified civic ledger-keeper desperate to prevent an unwashed docker from claiming the station manager's jubilee pot.
A greasy neon-lit kiosk crammed between two waste recycling ducts on the central promenade.

public_situation: Dockers in {system} are placing side-bets as habitat bailiffs surround a lottery kiosk after a common docker claimed the station anniversary jackpot.
private_truth: The lottery teller accidentally duplicated the station manager's pre-selected winning ticket barcode while trying to balance the till.

beats.public_change: Habitat security posts a notice claiming the lottery kiosk is closed for unexpected mechanical re-calibration.

missions.reason: The gambler needs raw ferrite ore delivered to weld protective blast grating over the kiosk window before bailiffs pry open the booth.
missions.private_fact: The gambler has not eaten solid food in four days, surviving on caffeinated tea while guarding the paper stub.

beats.public_change: The auditor threatens to vent the entire promenade ventilation shaft unless the ticket is surrendered.

missions.reason: The gambler asks the pilot to collect the original lottery printing stamp from the teller's pawned footlocker to prove the ticket was purchased legally.
missions.private_fact: The teller hid three counterfeit jackpot tickets in the same footlocker for future emergencies.

beats.public_change: The auditor convenes an emergency dockside tribunal outside the kiosk to declare the ticket invalid.

missions.reason: The teller asks the pilot to scan the kiosk transponder to prove the auditor deliberately wiped the ticket sale timestamp from the central server.
missions.private_fact: The auditor had pre-rigged the jackpot draw algorithm to award the grand prize to the station manager's brother-in-law.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the kiosk with proof that the entire jubilee sweepstakes was pre-rigged for the station manager. The sweating auditor offers a secret payoff.

options.label: Present the audit logs to force payout of the full jackpot to the impoverished docker
Broker a three-way split between the docker, the kiosk teller, and a dockworkers' holiday banquet
Surrender the ticket to the auditor in exchange for a confidential municipal transfer

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot proves the ticket is valid and forces full jackpot payout.
resolutions.summary: {role:superstitious_gambler} collects the staggering anniversary jackpot, buying the entire promenade bar ring while {role:habitat_auditor} is demoted.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a docker fairly won the rigged station anniversary jackpot.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a compromise banquet fund.
resolutions.summary: {role:superstitious_gambler} and {role:lottery_teller} share a generous settlement, funding a week of free oxygen and beer for all habitat dockers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the auditor's hush money.
resolutions.summary: {role:habitat_auditor} burns the winning ticket and rewards the pilot; {role:superstitious_gambler} is evicted for vagrancy while the manager keeps the pot.

resolutions.reached_by: The deliveries fail or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: Bailiffs bulldoze the kiosk and confiscate the ticket as forged; {role:superstitious_gambler} and {role:lottery_teller} are jailed for fraud.

loose_threads.detail: The lottery paper stock used for the winning jubilee ticket carries an embossed watermark from the governor's personal stationery suite.
Station finance ledgers show the anniversary prize fund was secretly financed by an uncollateralized line of credit from a freight cartel.

radio_hooks: Promenade lottery kiosk in {system} besieged by angry crowds over disputed jubilee ticket.
Habitat auditor claims technical glitch invalidated anniversary prize drawing.
Dockers hold impromptu street party outside barricaded lottery booth.

voice_direction.superstitious_gambler: Fast, manic, reciting numerical sequences with rapid cadence and treating a greasy lottery stub like a sacred holy relic.
voice_direction.lottery_teller: Slick, rapid, pitching superstitious odds and constantly looking over their shoulder toward the customs station.
voice_direction.habitat_auditor: High-strung, officious, citing station administrative bylaws in a shrill monotone while dabbing nervous sweat.
